blockedCommandHints.reason: Live social publishing mutates real channels and may send public posts.
blockedCommandHints.context: Run a dry-run first. Ask for explicit approval before live post/upload execution.
tryInstead: Run the same post command with `--dry-run --json`

blockedCommandHints.reason: Live comments/replies mutate real social channels.
blockedCommandHints.context: Run a dry-run first. Ask for explicit approval before live comment execution.
tryInstead: Run the same comment command with `--dry-run --json`

blockedCommandHints.reason: Live DMs send real private messages.
blockedCommandHints.context: Run a dry-run first. Ask for explicit approval before live DM execution.
tryInstead: Run the same DM command with `--dry-run --json`

blockedCommandHints.reason: Approved social execution can mutate real channels.
blockedCommandHints.context: Only execute a full dry-run result JSON after explicit user approval of the exact action.
tryInstead: Run a post/comment/DM dry-run with `--dry-run --json` first

blockedCommandHints.reason: Live Spotify playlist creation mutates the connected account and must not run directly.
blockedCommandHints.context: Save the dry-run JSON, obtain exact approval, then use the guarded social execute handoff so account verification and action provenance are re-checked.
tryInstead: Run the same playlist command with `--dry-run --json`
Run `node src/social.mjs execute --action-file <dry-run-result.json> --expected-action-id <act_...> --confirm yes --json` after approval
